en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph featuring an intricate Gothic church portal. The pointed arch is decorated with detailed carvings and a number of sculpted figures above the entrance. Two people, dressed in clothing typical of the late 19th or early 20th century, stand at the entrance. The wall behind the entrance and architectural details indicate an old European stone church.
